diagram_previews.alt: Right trapezoid ABCD with AB vertical on the left (right-angle marks at A and B), the short base AD at the bottom and the long base BC at the top. A blue inscribed circle touches all four sides; it touches the slanted side CD at E, with CE labelled 16 and ED labelled 4. A red dashed radius r runs from the centre to E, grey dashed radii go to the left and bottom sides, and a dotted vertical line drops from the top base to D.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
